verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a Windows support article title about backing up the BitLocker recovery key, which implies Windows ships its own disk-encryption feature (BitLocker). Nothing in the pack shows encryption is turned on automatically for a new user without manual setup. missing for 10: documentation that full-disk encryption is enabled by default or automatically at setup, details of which editions or hardware qualify, any description of BitLocker or device encryption itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I get full-disk encryption enabled automatically without manual security setup

citations.quote: Back up your BitLocker recovery key
